DDInter995.mechanism: Itraconazole exhibits a dose-related negative inotropic effect which may be additive to those of calcium channel blockers (CCBs). Significant increases of severalfold in felodipine and nifedipine plasma concentrations have been observed during coadministration with itraconazole, and there have been case reports of leg and ankle edema in patients treated with various itraconazole-dihydropyridine combinations.
